name: qbeta-c3-muon-anchor-codata-edition-attribution
description: qou-cds1 Finding B: the 3.4e-4 muon c_3 disagreement is the CODATA-2018 -> 2022 m_mu/m_e edition change (206.7682830 -> 206.7682827) amplified by the extractor's 1/u^3 = 1.6e6 lever, not a third value or a computation error. Residual after the edition is 5.0e-9, the corpus literal's own 9-sig-fig rounding. Prices the whole c_3 target against the CAL-1/2/3 published uncertainties.

assertions.name: inputs_are_full_published_precision_no_float_truncation
assertions.detail: constants.py reads the NIST table verbatim; q_muon_at reproduces the closed form from it to 1e-45 -- the gap is not a precision artefact

assertions.name: proton_solver_reproduces_q_at
assertions.detail: local transcription of the proton substrate identity == constants.q_at

assertions.name: proton_arm_reproduces_corpus_under_codata_2022
assertions.detail: |c_3(p) - corpus| = 0.308888 -- m_p/m_e barely moved between editions, so only the muon arm broke

assertions.name: residual_after_edition_is_the_corpus_literals_own_rounding
assertions.detail: residual -0.308888; c_3(2018) rounds to the corpus literal at the 9 sig figs it quotes -- nothing is left unexplained

assertions.name: attribution_is_the_17_digit_ancestor_not_the_frozen_pin
assertions.detail: frozen pin misses by 0.3089; the corpus c_3 is the CODATA-2018 ancestor q, not Q_MUON_50_DIGIT_STR

assertions.name: one_over_u_cubed_amplifies_the_anchor_drift_by_2e6
assertions.detail: 1/u^3 = 1618467.2, amplification 2.49012e+6 -- 'below the 11.5 ppb mu-p tension' does not imply below the resolution of what divides by u^3

assertions.name: cal_experimental_budget_swamps_the_disagreement
assertions.detail: c_3(muon) = -1.7109728 +- 0.7861 (Q_beta-dominated); disagreement is 0.3933 sigma; 0.338 sig figs supported vs 9 quoted

assertions.name: cross_anchor_swing_survives_common_mode_cancellation
assertions.detail: swing = -0.049482079 +- 0.005212 = 9.494 sigma; Q_beta cancels to 4.75e-7 -- the refutation's mechanism is experimentally supported, the absolute c_3 digits are not

assertions.name: kc21_scale_agreement_degrades_at_the_live_anchor
assertions.detail: Phi_b deficit vs |S_leak(muon)|: 3.29e+3 % at CODATA-2018 -> 3.29e+3 % at CODATA-2022. The deficit is anchor-blind, so KC21's quoted ~2.9 % is a superseded number rather than a property of the saddle

assertions.name: audit_quoted_S_muon_is_outside_its_own_rounding_window_now
assertions.detail: quoted 886.8 is 2.71e+3x outside its 4-s.f. window at the live pin; it reads 751.1 there -- a second CODATA-2018-era literal surfaced by the same edition step

context.axis: qou-cds1 Finding B attribution + CAL experimental budget on c_3
context.closes: Finding B is CLOSED as a defect: -2.01986031187 is not a third value, it is the CODATA-2022 evaluation of the same formula whose CODATA-2018 evaluation is the committed -2.02020024. The sensitivity probe's 8/9 is a stale regression target, not a bug.
context.opens: (i) the registry's 9-figure c_3 literals exceed what the CAL inputs support by ~8 figures; (ii) the corpus muon c_3 is on a superseded CODATA edition, as are the 336 files carrying the 17-digit ancestor q in this channel. Both are re-pin work sequenced behind PR #5500 and qou-1c4y; NOT done here.
